title: Over 84,000 fans rush to get tickets for Addison Rae's 'The Addison Tour' - NewsBreak
text: Addison Rae's tour gets an overwhelming response from fans. ​ Addison Rae has been making the waves ever since her debut namesake album Addison hit the charts. The singer who has taken the pop world by storm through her hit viral songs such as Diet Pepsi, Aquamarine, Headphones on, and more, along with guest appearances, featured performances, a Coachella debut and more, is now heading off to her first tour. The Addison Tour kicks off later on this year, and fans can't be more excited, as at the time of writing this piece, over 84,000 fans have been queued up to get the tickets. Addison Rae debuted her album earlier this month and celebrated the release with a cabaret-esque live performance in New York City in collaboration with Spotify. The album was released by Columbia Records and her self-owned record label, As Long As I'm Dancing LLC, and features 12 tracks. The entire album is produced by 3 women, including Addison Rae, and when asked about it, she told Variety: ​ Fans who have been waiting in the queues for hours or just otherwise share their endless demand for more seats and shows, as well as excitement for The Addison tour. ​ However, people also joked about how there really wasn't the need to create such a hype. ​ The Addison tour is set to kick off in Europe on August 26, heading to North America from there and finally ending in Australia. Tickets for the same can be bought from Live Nation and other service providers, while the Live Nation presale started on June 18, 2025. ​ ​ ​
